correctness.rationale: Both normalized subsequences have exact 2-adic index-isometries by additions (1), doubling valuations (2),(4) and telescoping. Thus they cover every class in separate even and odd 2-adic balls. The exhaustive finite verifier returned VERIFY_OK on 216 distinct (P,N) modular images, 54432 valuation pairs and 1080 doubling identities. All indices, boundary cases, signs and precisions are covered by the proof, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: Complete attainable-residue images modulo every 2-power, not only a noncompleteness certificate, answer the density question for the entire natural even-parameter Pell/Lucas family. Exact isometries establish that both balls are attained without omissions, and yield a nontrivial parameter-dependent Haar density and explicit finite-level count.
